name: bell-button
title: Bell Button
description: A notification toggle whose bell swings and rings when switched on, with an unread badge, and goes quiet with a slash when off.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Controlled state. true means notifications are on.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the button is pressed.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible text next to the bell. Empty for an icon-only button.

props.name: count
props.description: Unread count shown as a badge while on. Hidden at 0.
